notes: Tor exit IPs that actually make a request to the gateway are now also registered in Blocked IPs and (if configured) cPanel's IP Blocker - not the whole exit-node list, just the ones that hit you - with a flat block duration (default 14 days, adjustable under Security > Settings) since a Tor exit node doesn't have a 'repeat offender' the way a single abusive IP does. Also adds automatic cleanup: whenever any auto-block (Tor or otherwise) expires, it now gets removed from cPanel's IP Blocker too, not just marked inactive locally - previously it would have stayed blocked at the web-server level forever. No database update needed for this update.
